mcq.s: The basis of DNA fingerprinting is:
mcq.x: DNA fingerprinting compares highly variable (polymorphic) repeat regions of DNA that differ from person to person.

mcq.s: Which one of the following techniques can be used to establish the paternity of a child?
mcq.x: DNA fingerprinting establishes paternity because a child inherits its polymorphic DNA bands from both parents.
